name: value_composite
note: After O'Shaughnessy's value composite (What Works on Wall Street): among the 500 largest excluding Financials with positive P/E, P/B, EV/EBIT and sales, the 25 best summed ranks on P/B, P/E, price to sales, EV/EBIT and shareholder yield. EV/EBIT stands in for EV/EBITDA and P/CF is left out (no cash flow column), so it is a close cousin, not a replica.
